sources.note: Nothing. Table 1 (p.48) lists Si 'Probably extinct', Gana 'Possibly spoken', Takaya 'Probably extinct', sole sources Gowers (1907) and Shimizu (1982). Sec. 3.1 Phonology describes eBoze only; the one general remark is that other East Kainji languages 'have much reduced [tone] systems' and that Shimizu (1979, 1982a) transcribes tone as High/Low or High/Low/Downstep. Lere cluster data limited to 'arm' (Si aya, Gana u-?aya, Takaya aya). 'stress' occurs nowhere.
